ui.title: eufy recording export
ui.intro: Connect your account to read historical event recordings from your HomeBase 3.
ui.country.hint: Use the account region shown in the eufy app, such as US, CA or CN.
ui.timezone: Times use America/Toronto, including daylight saving time. Your computer and HomeBase 3 must be on the same LAN.
ui.saved.hint: These files are saved on this computer. Times come from the event index; clips may include pre-recorded footage. Event clips do not guarantee coverage of the entire requested interval.
ui.privacy: This page is provided by your local project, not eufy. Passwords and pending challenges are transient. A valid resident session token may be saved locally for restart restoration; signing out clears it.
ui.disconnected: The local service disconnected. Please restart the project.
ui.unreachable: Cannot connect to the local service. Check that the project is running.
ui.recordings.unreachable: Cannot connect to the recording service.
ui.recordings.unavailable: The recording service is temporarily unavailable.
ui.error.localPage: Please submit from the local sign-in page.
ui.error.credentials: Enter your email, password and two-letter country code.
ui.error.verifyFirst: Sign in first, then enter the verification code.
ui.sharedHint: The assistant composes these results. Pin results to keep them after refresh; their data is loaded from the local service.
ui.agentHint: Ask for a camera, calendar date and time range. Missing details will be clarified here.
ui.agentPrivacy: Use the normal sign-in form for passwords and verification codes. Never put them in chat.
ui.agentRunning: Assistant is working. You can switch views or refresh; resident work continues.
ui.indexHint: Index ranges show available footage, not proof of complete coverage.
ui.job.partial: Partial — playable footage is not complete
ui.error.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Local service unavailable. Existing work keeps its identity; refresh to reconnect.
ui.error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Complete sign-in using the normal form.
ui.error.TURN_BUSY: Another conversation turn is running. Wait for it to finish.
ui.error.AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is not configured. Normal browsing is available.
ui.error.AGENT_FAILED: The assistant could not finish this turn. Existing jobs continue; review their status before continuing.
ui.error.TURN_INTERRUPTED: The resident restarted. Existing jobs remain available; send a new message to continue.
ui.error.CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED: More details are needed. Specify the device, calendar date and start/end times.
ui.error.AMBIGUOUS_DEVICE: More than one device matches. Select a listed serial in your next message.
ui.error.DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: No matching device. Use a listed device name or serial.
ui.error.NO_RECORDING: No footage was found; no export was submitted.
ui.error.DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The recording device could not be reached. Check its connection.
ui.error.SERVICE_BUSY: The resident is busy with another operation. Existing work continues.
ui.error.INTERFACE_UNAVAILABLE: Conversation state is unavailable. Check the resident service.
ui.error.INVALID_WINDOW: Use a valid calendar date and ordered times within the same day.
ui.error.AMBIGUOUS_OR_NONEXISTENT_TIME: This local time is ambiguous or does not exist. Choose an unambiguous time.
ui.error.UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE: This device is not eligible for recording export.
ui.error.PARTIAL_RECORDING: Only partial footage was recovered. Playback does not prove full coverage.
ui.error.EXPORT_FAILED: Recording export failed. Review the job diagnostics.
ui.error.LOGIN_REQUIRED: Sign in using the normal form before starting new work.
ui.error.JOB_NOT_FOUND: Task not found. Check the task ID.
ui.error.JOB_UNAVAILABLE: The export could not be started. Check existing tasks before continuing.
ui.error.CAPABILITY_RECORDS_UNAVAILABLE: Device verification records are unavailable. Check the local service.
ui.error.SERVICE_STOPPING: The local service is shutting down. Reconnect after it restarts.
ui.error.INTERNAL_ERROR: The local service could not complete this request. Check its status before continuing.
ui.error.INVALID_RESPONSE: The local service returned an unexpected response. Check its status before continuing.
ui.error.NORMALIZATION_REQUIRED: First specify the device and recording time to find available footage.
ui.reason.inventory_does_not_prove_reach: The device list does not confirm whether this device is online.
ui.reason.homebase_address_missing: HomeBase cannot be found. Check its local network connection.
ui.workspaceUnsupported: This result cannot be displayed. Ask the assistant to show a supported result.
ui.workspaceUnavailable: This result is not available yet. Check the local service or sign in; it will be checked again automatically.
